title: 第12单元：安全文化与人的因素
source_doc: course/Acids, Bases & Solvents Safety/01_Module 12 — Safety Culture & Human Factors.md
author_source: project/Acids, Bases & Solvents Safety/01_Module 12 — Safety Culture & Human Factors/src.py

points.K1: 文化决定没人看时怎么做
points.K2: 合规是底线，文化定高度
points.K5: 差错是系统问题的症状
points.K12: 小差错用改流程来处理
points.K18: 投入什么就是重视什么
points.K19: 管理合规，还是引领文化

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验室门口，身旁一本合上的安全手册
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a laboratory door beside a closed blank safety manual on a small stand and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲安全文化和人的因素。
overlay: 第12单元：安全文化与人的因素

shots.scene: 手册、人群、天平、上升箭头四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a closed blank manual, a group of people, a balance scale and an upward arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 从守规矩，到人人自觉守安全。

shots.scene: 深夜实验室，阿杰揉着眼睛，伸手去拿一瓶试剂
shots.prompt_en: Late at night in a lab, the young male student rubs his tired eyes and reaches for a blank reagent bottle on a shelf.
shots.narration: 阿杰连熬两晚，伸手拿试剂。

shots.scene: 两只外观相似的空白试剂瓶，被拿起的那只打了红叉
shots.prompt_en: Two similar blank reagent bottles side by side; the one being picked up is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 差一点就拿错了瓶子。

shots.scene: 阿杰把瓶子放回去，紧张地四下张望
shots.prompt_en: The young male student quietly puts the bottle back on the shelf and glances around nervously.
shots.narration: 他心想：没出事，就别说了吧。

shots.scene: 小研走过来，拍拍他的肩，指向一张空白记录表
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks over, pats the young male student on the shoulder and points to a blank record form on the wall.
shots.narration: 小研说：险情说出来，大家都受益。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在空白白板前，竖起一根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 愿不愿说，就看实验室的文化。

shots.section_title: 文化决定没人看时怎么做
shots.scene: 书架上整齐的安全手册，蒙着一层灰
shots.prompt_en: A neat row of blank safety manuals on a shelf, covered with a thin layer of dust. No people.
shots.narration: 手册写得再好，也可能只在架上。
overlay: 文化决定没人看时怎么做

shots.section_title: 文化决定没人看时怎么做
shots.scene: 实验室里没有老师，小研仍然戴好护目镜做实验
shots.prompt_en: In a lab with no supervisor present, the female graduate student still puts on safety goggles before working at the bench.
shots.narration: 没人看着时怎么做，由文化决定。

shots.section_title: 文化决定没人看时怎么做
shots.scene: 左边一张被要求签字的表格，右边一颗心形图标
shots.prompt_en: Split icon: on the left a blank form with a pen, on the right a heart symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 合规是被要求做，文化是自己选。

shots.section_title: 合规是底线，文化定高度
shots.scene: 一条地面线，线上方有向上的箭头
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram: a horizontal floor line with an upward arrow rising above it. No people.
shots.narration: 合规只是底线，告诉你最低要求。
overlay: 合规是底线，文化定高度

shots.section_title: 合规是底线，文化定高度
shots.scene: 制药实验室设备崭新，一名学生匆匆跳过一个步骤
shots.prompt_en: In a modern lab with brand-new equipment, the young male student hurries and skips a step, leaving a blank checklist unchecked.
shots.narration: 制药实验室设备一流，人照样跳步骤。

shots.section_title: 合规是底线，文化定高度
shots.scene: 秒表图标压过盾牌图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a stopwatch placed above a shield icon, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 因为环境暗中奖励了快，而非稳。

shots.section_title: 合规是底线，文化定高度
shots.scene: 盾牌图标在上，秒表在下，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a shield placed above a stopwatch with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 文化要让稳妥比快更受认可。

shots.scene: 五级台阶图标，从下往上逐级变亮
shots.prompt_en: Five steps of a staircase icon, lighting up one by one from bottom to top. No people.
shots.narration: 安全文化通常分五个阶段。

shots.scene: 最低一级台阶上，一只手把破碎烧杯藏进柜子，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: On the lowest step, an icon of a hand hiding a broken beaker in a cabinet, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 最低一级：不被发现就行，掩盖问题。

shots.scene: 第二级台阶：事故警示图标后面才出现扳手
shots.prompt_en: On the second step, a wrench icon appears only after an accident warning icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第二级：出了事才去整改。

shots.scene: 第三级台阶：检查表和放大镜图标
shots.prompt_en: On the third step, icons of a blank checklist and a magnifying glass. No people.
shots.narration: 第三级：靠检查和制度推着走。

shots.scene: 老周和小研在实验台前一起看空白风险清单
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the female graduate student look over a blank risk list together at a lab bench before starting work.
shots.narration: 第四级：主动预判危险。

shots.scene: 第五级台阶发光，上面是灯泡和人群图标
shots.prompt_en: The fifth step glows, topped with icons of a light bulb and a group of people. No people.
shots.narration: 最高一级：安全融入每个决定。

shots.scene: 台阶中间一级被高亮，许多小人图标聚在那里
shots.prompt_en: The middle step of the staircase is highlighted, with many small person icons crowded on it. No people.
shots.narration: 多数单位停在中间，靠检查推动。

shots.scene: 日历一页页翻过，台阶上的小人慢慢向上走
shots.prompt_en: Calendar pages flip by while a small person icon slowly climbs from the third step to the fourth. No people.
shots.narration: 从第三级到第四级，要好几年。

shots.scene: 老周在组会上对大家点头鼓励
shots.prompt_en: The older man nods encouragingly at a small group meeting with students around a table.
shots.narration: 文化不会一夜改变，要坚持。

shots.section_title: 差错是系统问题的症状
shots.scene: 放大镜下的人形图标，背后连着齿轮、时钟、书本
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass over a person icon, connected behind to gears, a clock and a book. No people.
shots.narration: 人犯错，往往是系统出了问题。
overlay: 差错是系统问题的症状

shots.section_title: 差错是系统问题的症状
shots.scene: 欣欣指着冰山图标，水下部分更大
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at an iceberg icon with a much larger part under the water.
shots.narration: 差错只是症状，根子在下面。

shots.scene: 几片带孔的奶酪片排成一排，一支箭头穿过对齐的孔
shots.prompt_en: Several slices of Swiss cheese lined up in a row, an arrow passing through holes that happen to line up. No people.
shots.narration: 每道防线都有漏洞，像奶酪片。

shots.scene: 孔对齐时箭头穿过所有奶酪片，末端是事故警示图标
shots.prompt_en: When all the holes align, the arrow passes through every slice and reaches a warning triangle icon. No people.
shots.narration: 漏洞刚好对齐，事故就发生了。

shots.scene: 最前面一片奶酪上有一个拿错东西的手的图标
shots.prompt_en: On the front cheese slice, an icon of a hand grabbing the wrong item. No people.
shots.narration: 一线的失误，是看得见的漏洞。

shots.scene: 后面几片奶酪上分别有时钟、空白证书和坏扳手图标
shots.prompt_en: On the back cheese slices, icons of a ticking clock, a blank certificate and a broken wrench. No people.
shots.narration: 赶进度、缺培训、设备坏是暗洞。

shots.scene: 一个自燃危险品图标放在手套箱图标外面，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: A pyrophoric hazard pictogram placed outside a glove box icon, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 有案例：危险品没在手套箱里操作。

shots.scene: 空白能力考核表和时钟图标叠在一起，旁边是警示图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank competency assessment form and a clock icon overlapping, next to a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 又没考核能力，又赶进度，酿成悲剧。

shots.scene: 左边大脑图标，右边警示三角图标
shots.prompt_en: Split screen icons: a brain on the left and a warning triangle on the right. No people.
shots.narration: 差错分两类，对策不一样。

shots.scene: 小研拿起瓶子又迟疑，旁边一张空白检查表
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student picks up a blank bottle, hesitates, and checks a blank checklist on the bench.
shots.narration: 拿错瓶、漏一步，是无心之失。

shots.scene: 检查表和带凹槽的托盘图标，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a blank checklist and a tray with shaped slots, with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 靠检查表和好设计来防。

shots.scene: 抄近路的脚印图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of footprints taking a shortcut across a lawn, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 故意走捷径，检查表管不住。

shots.scene: 王老师给学生上课，旁边是空白规程和人群图标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator teaches a group of students next to a blank procedure board.
shots.narration: 要靠培训、清楚的规程和文化。

shots.scene: 阿杰趴在实验台边打瞌睡，旁边时钟指向深夜
shots.prompt_en: The young male student dozes off at the edge of a lab bench, a wall clock showing late night.
shots.narration: 连续熬夜，人的判断力会下降。

shots.scene: 电池图标电量见底，旁边一只摇晃的手
shots.prompt_en: An almost empty battery icon next to an icon of a shaky hand. No people.
shots.narration: 连续工作24小时，如同醉酒。

shots.scene: 排班表图标，每格都有休息的月亮
shots.prompt_en: A blank shift schedule grid icon with a small moon symbol in each rest slot. No people.
shots.narration: 合理排班，限制连续工作时间。

shots.scene: 欣欣把一个圆形塞子放进圆孔，方形放不进
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot fits a round plug into a round hole while a square plug does not fit.
shots.narration: 别跟人性较劲，按人的特点设计。

shots.scene: 三种颜色的废液桶，各配形状不同的漏斗
shots.prompt_en: Three waste containers in different colors, each with a funnel of a matching unique shape. No people.
shots.narration: 颜色加形状，漏斗只插得进对的桶。

shots.scene: 错位的漏斗插不进桶口，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A funnel of the wrong shape cannot fit into a container opening, marked with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 想倒错都倒不进去。

shots.scene: 安静整洁的实验台，墙上时钟不急
shots.prompt_en: A quiet, tidy lab bench with a calm wall clock and no clutter. No people.
shots.narration: 少些干扰，少些赶工压力。

shots.scene: 阿杰犹豫后走向小研，手里拿着空白险情报告单
shots.prompt_en: The young male student walks hesitantly toward the female graduate student holding a blank near-miss report form.
shots.narration: 公正文化：诚实的失误不责备。

shots.scene: 报告单图标越堆越多，旁边一个上升箭头
shots.prompt_en: A stack of blank report form icons growing taller next to an upward arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 不怕挨骂，险情报告才会多起来。

shots.scene: 三个分类箱图标排成一排
shots.prompt_en: Three sorting bin icons in a row, each with a different symbol: a slipping hand, a question mark and a red flame. No people.
shots.narration: 行为分三类，处理各不同。

shots.scene: 第一个箱子旁是齿轮扳手图标
shots.prompt_en: Next to the first bin, an icon of a gear and a wrench. No people.
shots.narration: 无心差错：不责备，改进系统。

shots.scene: 老周坐在阿杰身边耐心讲解
shots.prompt_en: The older man sits beside the young male student at a bench and patiently explains something.
shots.narration: 没意识到风险：辅导他，而非惩罚。

shots.scene: 一条近路被封上，另一条安全路径更短更亮
shots.prompt_en: A diagram where a risky shortcut is blocked and the safe path is made shorter and brighter. No people.
shots.narration: 让安全的做法更方便。

shots.scene: 第三个箱子旁是天平和空白处理决定书图标
shots.prompt_en: Next to the third bin, icons of a balance of justice and a blank decision letter. No people.
shots.narration: 明知危险还硬干，要严肃问责。

shots.section_title: 小差错用改流程来处理
shots.scene: 笔记本上一个抄错的数字图标，旁边是流程图
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a notebook with one miscopied number, next to a simple process flow diagram. No people.
shots.narration: 抄错一个数，改流程，不写检讨。
overlay: 小差错用改流程来处理

shots.section_title: 小差错用改流程来处理
shots.scene: 小研在组会上举手说出一次险情，大家点头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student raises her hand at a group meeting to share a close call, and others nod.
shots.narration: 大家才敢说出险情。

shots.scene: 老周站在组会白板前讲话
shots.prompt_en: The older man speaks in front of a blank whiteboard at a lab group meeting.
shots.narration: 负责人关注什么，大家就重视什么。

shots.scene: 两个对话气泡：指向别人的手指被划掉，换成围成一圈的人
shots.prompt_en: Two speech bubble icons: a pointing finger crossed out, replaced by a circle of people holding hands. No people.
shots.narration: 多说我们，少说你。

shots.scene: 人形图标换成齿轮图标
shots.prompt_en: A person icon being replaced by a gear system icon. No people.
shots.narration: 多说系统问题，少说某人失误。

shots.scene: 空白报告单上有个学习的灯泡图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank report form icon with a light bulb symbol on it. No people.
shots.narration: 险情，是我们学到东西的机会。

shots.scene: 红色停止手势图标，旁边一颗星
shots.prompt_en: A raised hand stop gesture icon with a small star beside it, meaning praise. No people.
shots.narration: 有人喊停，要表扬。

shots.scene: 对话气泡里一个狂奔的时钟，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: A speech bubble containing a running clock icon, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别说“赶紧弄完”，这会催出捷径。

shots.scene: 老周走进实验室，和小研、阿杰交谈
shots.prompt_en: The older man walks into the lab and chats with the female graduate student and the young male student at their bench.
shots.narration: 负责人走到现场，比开会更管用。

shots.scene: 老周弯腰看实验台，认真倾听阿杰
shots.prompt_en: The older man leans over the bench, looking closely and listening carefully to the young male student.
shots.narration: 多问开放问题，多看，多听。

shots.scene: 险情报告上升箭头，事故下降箭头
shots.prompt_en: Two arrows: an upward arrow next to a report form icon and a downward arrow next to a warning icon. No people.
shots.narration: 每月巡查后，险情报告升，事故降。

shots.scene: 走廊里，老周快步赶来，王老师已在门口
shots.prompt_en: In a hallway, the older man hurries toward a lab door where the safety administrator is already waiting.
shots.narration: 出了事，负责人要尽快到场。

shots.scene: 老周关切地扶着受伤的阿杰坐下
shots.prompt_en: The older man gently helps the young male student, whose hand is bandaged, sit down on a chair.
shots.narration: 先关心受影响的人。

shots.scene: 老周对着全组讲话，身后空白白板
shots.prompt_en: The older man talks openly to the whole lab group in front of a blank whiteboard.
shots.narration: 如实通报，找原因，不找替罪羊。

shots.scene: 一把挡在面前的盾牌和锁的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a shield and a padlock held up defensively, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 推卸躲闪，文化就会垮掉。

shots.scene: 仪表盘图标：一边是后视镜，一边是望远镜
shots.prompt_en: A dashboard icon with a rear-view mirror on one side and a telescope on the other. No people.
shots.narration: 看安全，既看结果，也看苗头。

shots.scene: 事故次数柱状图图标
shots.prompt_en: A simple bar chart icon counting accidents. No people.
shots.narration: 美国监管的可记录事故是滞后指标。

shots.scene: 险情报告和巡查次数的折线图图标
shots.prompt_en: A line chart icon tracking near-miss reports and completed safety walks. No people.
shots.narration: 险情报告、巡查次数是领先指标。

shots.scene: 日历和刷新箭头图标
shots.prompt_en: A calendar icon with a circular refresh arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 安全制度要定期修订更新。

shots.scene: 芯片、双螺旋、纳米颗粒三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a computer chip, a DNA double helix and a cluster of nanoparticles. No people.
shots.narration: 新技术会带来新危害，要提前想。

shots.scene: 欣欣拿着放大镜望向远处
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a magnifying glass and looks into the distance.
shots.narration: 不更新的制度，已经过时。

shots.section_title: 投入什么就是重视什么
shots.scene: 钱袋图标流向盾牌图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a money bag flowing toward a shield icon. No people.
shots.narration: 安全要投入真金白银。
overlay: 投入什么就是重视什么

shots.section_title: 投入什么就是重视什么
shots.scene: 老李在实验室安装新的手套箱和可调高度的工作台
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer installs a new glove box and a height-adjustable workbench in the lab.
shots.narration: 看得见的投入，胜过千场幻灯片培训。

shots.section_title: 投入什么就是重视什么
shots.scene: 欣欣站在新设备旁竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot gives a thumbs-up beside the newly installed equipment.
shots.narration: 投入什么，就是重视什么。

shots.section_title: 管理合规，还是引领文化
shots.scene: 镜子图标映出实验室、钱袋和报告单
shots.prompt_en: A mirror icon reflecting small icons of a lab, a money bag and a report form. No people.
shots.narration: 看看自己的实验室、投入和报告。
overlay: 管理合规，还是引领文化

shots.section_title: 管理合规，还是引领文化
shots.scene: 左边打勾的表格，右边一群人一起举手
shots.prompt_en: Split icons: on the left a form with tick boxes, on the right a group of people raising hands together. No people.
shots.narration: 是在打勾应付，还是在建设文化？

shots.scene: 欣欣站在五级台阶图标旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a five-step staircase icon.
shots.narration: 合规是底线，文化决定高度。

shots.scene: 奶酪片和齿轮图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of Swiss cheese slices and a gear. No people.
shots.narration: 差错多是系统问题，按人设计。

shots.scene: 三个分类箱图标
shots.prompt_en: Three sorting bin icons in a row. No people.
shots.narration: 差错改系统，冒险要辅导，鲁莽问责。

shots.scene: 巡查的脚印和报告单图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of walking footprints and a blank report form. No people.
shots.narration: 负责人走到现场，险情及时报告。

shots.scene: 仪表盘和钱袋图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a dashboard with two gauges and a money bag. No people.
shots.narration: 看领先指标，投入什么就重视什么。

shots.scene: 欣欣和小研、阿杰、老周站在一起挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye together with the female graduate student, the young male student and the older man in a tidy lab.
shots.narration: 安全是大家的事，下次见！
